title: DTN C: wall-clock expiry with fail-open when clock invalid (R-05-080 MUST)
description: Child of b7z9.8. coap_dtn.c:53-56 dtn_get_unix_time() returns k_uptime_get()/1000 (uptime AS Unix time), used for expiry sweeps (:62 :89), store TTL (:159-160), senml ts (:209), pickup (:284) - violates spec 05-routing.md 9.8 R-05-080 (clockless nodes MUST NOT drop on expiry timestamp alone) and docs/firmware-time-provider.md:110-111 (never synthesize Unix time from uptime). Fix: use lichen_wall_clock_valid()/lichen_wall_clock_get() (link.h:838-839, implemented in time_sync.c) for all expiry decisions; when the clock is invalid, skip expiry sweeps and do not synthesize an expiry from uptime (fail open: store/forward, let downstream nodes with valid time enforce). Keep caller-visible behavior otherwise unchanged. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c (+ test if a harness exists). No dependency on the HBH wire-format child.
close_reason: DTN wall-clock fix per R-05-080 landed: (1) coap_dtn.c dtn_get_unix_time() no longer returns uptime/1000 — now lichen_wall_clock_valid() ? lichen_wall_clock_get() : 0U, guarded by #if defined(CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC) (time_sync.c links only under that Kconfig; #else is permanently clockless and returns the 0 sentinel, avoiding the jqzc-style unguarded-symbol link failure); (2) the deaddrop store path sets expiry = (now != 0) ? now + TTL : 0U — a clockless node stores the fail-open sentinel instead of synthesizing a deadline from uptime; (3) lichen_dtn_expire_old and lichen_dtn_buffer_message (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/dtn.c) treat expiry_unix == 0 as the no-validated-deadline sentinel: always admitted, never locally flushed — mirroring the router.c bpyr fix; downstream nodes with valid time enforce; (4) dtn.h param/return docs updated. All four dtn_get_unix_time call sites coherent (register sweep, periodic sweep, store, senml ts — senml_pack_init treats 0 as no-base-time, so a clockless node omits bt rather than leaking uptime; pickup frees sentinel records normally). Verification: standalone behavioral check of dtn.c (freestanding TU): fail-open record admitted, clockless sweep (now 0) flushes nothing, valid-clock sweep expires only the deadline record — all asserts pass; cppcheck R-APPC-011 gate exit 0. No host test dir exists for coap_dtn.c (Zephyr-coupled: k_mutex/k_work/coap_service) — noted. Worker-6's reported main-side routing_dispatch red (test_dtn_hbh_option_parsing) concerns the router.c expire semantics from the b7z9.4.1-thread lineage and does not reproduce on beads-worker-7 (suite green). Codereview 3x (Kimi K3): correctness PASS (all call sites coherent, guard correct vs the jqzc pattern), security PASS (DoS bounded: sentinel records only via OSCORE-or-local-admin rate-limited POST; capacity eviction ignores the sentinel exemption; fail-open default is correct for a store-and-forward module), edge PASS (senml bt omission is the no-time convention matching coap_location.c; dtn.h docs match implementation).
